# 4. Reflect

Reflect on what you've learned while getting set up. Is there anything that jumped out at you? Anything you found particularly interesting or confusing? Write at least a paragraph and include at least one question.

Submit your assignment by pushing your work to your course GitHub repository. (Detailed GitHub submission instructions coming soon.)
